title: 魟魚第七圈
subject: a man spending a whole rainy afternoon on the bench in an aquarium's underwater tunnel, counting the laps of one manta ray over his head
caption: Mandarin shoegaze in the early-1990s glide-guitar style. Layered fuzz guitars with reverse reverb forming a wall; a lead guitar bending notes with the tremolo arm; a melodic bass carrying the tune under the noise; steady mid-tempo drums with washy cymbals; a faint organ drone. Dense wall of sound, vocals sunk under the guitars, smeared cymbals, warm tape hiss. Soft male tenor, breathy and half-whispered, buried in the mix. 92 BPM, A major. Drowsy, blurred and oddly comforted. No bright pop production, no autotune, no trap or EDM drums, no guitar solo shredding, no clean acoustic strumming.
lyrics:
[Intro - feedback guitars and slow drums]

[Verse 1]
下雨的禮拜二 水族館沒什麼人
我坐在隧道中間 那張藍色的長凳
頭上那隻魟魚 慢慢地游過來
肚子白白的 好像在對我笑

[Pre-Chorus]
小朋友走了 導覽也走了
只剩我 跟玻璃後面的牠

[Chorus]
第七圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
外面的雨 跟我無關
第七圈 我也不想走

[Verse 2]
手機沒電了 也沒人在找我
上班的事 暫時放在門口
牠翻了個身 影子蓋住我的臉
整條隧道 安靜得像水底

[Pre-Chorus]
廣播說 再半小時要關門了
我說好 再等牠一圈

[Chorus]
第八圈 牠又經過我
不趕時間 也不說什麼
明天的雨 我再來看
第八圈 我才捨得走

[Outro - guitars dissolving into drone]
藍藍的 慢慢的
